segments.caption: A news report details a train collision with a car in Douglasville, Georgia, showing an aerial view of the accident scene with emergency vehicles, a map pinpointing the location at the intersection of E Broad St and Mozley St, and a reporter on location providing updates.

A CBS Atlanta news reporter provides a live on-site update at night in Douglasville, Georgia, following a train collision with a car. The report begins with a graphic map pinpointing the incident at the intersection of E Broad St and Mozley St, and the reporter gestures toward the dark, empty road to indicate the location of the crash.

A live news report from Douglasville, Georgia, at night shows a reporter gesturing toward a scene where a train has collided with a vehicle on the tracks. The footage transitions to daytime aerial and ground-level views, revealing emergency responders and railroad personnel at the scene of the accident, where a train has struck a red car.

A news report captures the aftermath of a car crash at a railroad crossing in Atlanta. The first frame shows a red sedan, its hood crumpled, having collided with a train. The subsequent frames show the crossing with traffic flowing, and a man in a black hoodie is interviewed on location, providing a witness account of the incident.

A news reporter stands at a railroad crossing in Atlanta, where cars navigate the intersection with the tracks. The footage highlights the crossing's infrastructure, including the rails, gravel bed, and traffic signals, while a white pickup truck and other vehicles pass by, emphasizing the daily traffic flow at this busy urban junction.

A news report from Atlanta details a train derailment incident. The segment opens with a close-up of a damaged railroad crossing, followed by a reporter on-site speaking to the camera. The footage then cuts to aerial views of the scene, showing a red car that has collided with a train, with emergency vehicles and personnel present.

A news report covers a serious train collision involving a red car and a truck on railroad tracks. The scene, shown from an aerial view, depicts emergency response and a tow truck at the site. The report is anchored by field reporter Steve Kiggins, who provides live updates from the location at night.
